market_fee_parameters: REQUIRED at T0 with original raw bytes, by token/market/version. sample rate 0.07 and exponent 1 are NOT defaults
market_specific_taker_fee_schedule_statu: F0 metadata observed, but no custodied original T0 fee bytes
exit_formula: sum(filled_shares * (executable_exit_bid - executable_entry_ask)) - entry_fee - exit_fee - slippage - impact - other_costs
expected_hold_formula: E_filled_shares * (frozen_calibrated_q - ask) - expected_market_fee - slippage - other_costs; disallow RAW_CONVICTION as q
early_exit: MUST use actual bid and independent exit depth
pair_upper_bound: shares*(1-vwap_ask_up-vwap_ask_down)-fees_up-fees_down-other_costs; BOTH tokens same condition_id; upper quote only
pair_lower_bound: null until independent two-leg fill and risk custody

f1_precision_contract.science_gate: NO ECONOMIC ADMISSION without original T0 market-specific fee schedule, rounding and fill evidence
